name: Fuchsbau-Rodeln in Serfaus
beschreibung:
=== description ===
The Fuchsbau Sled Run in Serfaus is one of the longest family sled runs in Tyrol. Over a 6.5-kilometer winding trail, it descends from the middle station all the way down to Serfaus. In the evenings, enchanting lighting illuminates the run—sledding under the starry sky is an unforgettable winter experience.
